launcher.notes: Engine Launcher v1.1.5: Built-in uninstall manager for all suite tools with confirmation dialog and user data / custom chart protection.

beatup.notes: BeatUp Engine v1.3.3: Native Direct3D 11 backend & DXGI Flip Model (fixes 290 FPS cap on Windows 11/RTX), zero-allocation combo text caching, single-pass foreground border/shadow, and fixed diagnostics timing.

silencer.notes: Silencer v2.1 Audio & BPM Prep Tool: Native DirectX 11 / ImGui rendering, enhanced BPM detection kit, exact madi offset calculation and trim silence.

onetwo.notes: One Two Party Engine v0.1: Authentic rhythm engine featuring arrow sequences, listen-and-repeat mechanics, 4-field chart editor, and live Audition player.
